summary: These 14 cases cover the coupon rules: the code format, the discount range, the minimum subtotal, usage limits, lockout, and how the discount shows up on downstream documents. The boundary cases probe every limit that was computed locally.

test_cases.title: Valid 20% coupon reduces the item subtotal
preconditions: Cart subtotal 180 AED, delivery fee 20 AED

test_cases.title: Coupon code is not case-sensitive
test_cases.expected_result: The coupon is accepted and the same discount as SAVE20 is applied

test_cases.title: Fixed coupon applies a set amount
test_cases.expected_result: The total drops by exactly 20.00 AED

test_cases.title: Code length at the boundaries (5, 6, 12, 13 characters)
preconditions: Active codes exist with 6 and 12 characters
test_cases.expected_result: 6 and 12 characters are accepted; 5 and 13 are rejected with a format error

test_cases.title: Minimum subtotal at the boundaries (99, 100, 101 AED)
steps: Set the subtotal to 99, 100 and 101 AED in turn
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected at 99 AED; accepted at 100 and 101 AED

test_cases.title: Percentage limits (4, 5, 50, 51 percent)
test_cases.expected_result: 5 and 50 percent are allowed; 4 and 51 percent are rejected when the coupon is created

test_cases.title: Fixed coupon larger than the subtotal
test_cases.expected_result: The item total floors at 0.00 AED, only the delivery fee is charged, and the total is never negative

test_cases.title: Lockout after 5 invalid attempts in 10 minutes
test_cases.expected_result: After the 5th attempt coupon entry is locked for 15 minutes, and the valid code is rejected while the lock lasts

test_cases.title: Expired coupon is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: The coupon is rejected with an expiry message and the total is unchanged

test_cases.title: Usage limit reached
preconditions: The shopper already used WELCOME once
steps: Apply WELCOME on a new order

test_cases.title: Special characters in the code
test_cases.expected_result: Format error; no request reaches the pricing service

test_cases.title: Coupon removed when the subtotal drops below 100 AED
test_cases.expected_result: The coupon is removed, a message explains why, and the total is recalculated

test_cases.title: Discount on the confirmation email and the invoice PDF
test_cases.expected_result: Both show the coupon code and a 36.00 AED discount that matches the order summary

test_cases.title: Two sessions apply a single-use coupon at the same time
preconditions: The same shopper is logged in on two devices
steps: Place two orders with the coupon at the same moment
test_cases.expected_result: Only one order gets the discount

coverage_notes: Every numeric limit in the requirement has a below / at / above probe.
The requirement does not say whether VAT is applied before or after the discount, so tax calculation is not covered.
Time-zone handling for expiry dates should be confirmed (local time or UTC).
automation_candidates: TC-001 to TC-011 at the API level (fast, data-driven over the probe values)
TC-012 and TC-013 as end-to-end UI tests, with an email inbox API and PDF text checks
TC-014 as a concurrency test against the orders API
